parsed.change_summary: Changed the comparison function pointer signature from 'int (*cmp)(T&, T&)' to 'int (*cmp)(const T&, const T&)' in the mergeSort and merge functions.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger is blocked because the comparison function pointer now requires 'const' references to the data, preventing the attacker from modifying the data which could lead to arbitrary code execution.
